P0-01.title: Reconnect / Retry Button Performs Read-Only Poll Instead of Real Recovery
P0-01.implementation: Split UI into #nvBtnRefreshDiagnostics (read-only GET /api/v8/verdi/live-status) and #nvBtnRetryConnection (POST /api/v8/verdi/recover executing 15-step recovery state machine). Also fixed _resolve_ssh_extra_args() to always pass -F ~/.ssh/config.

P0-02.title: Hardcoded Multi-Device Registry Booleans
P0-02.implementation: Replaced hardcoded website_reachable=True, xquartz_running=True, open_source_eda_ready=True on Device A (macbook_air) with real measured heartbeat store (state_store/device_heartbeats_v81.json, 60s TTL).

P0-03.title: No Real Remote Companion Transport Between iMac and MacBook Air
P0-03.implementation: Implemented signed device pairing (POST /api/v8/devices/pair), revocation (POST /api/v8/devices/revoke), authenticated heartbeat ingestion (POST /api/v8/devices/heartbeat), and remote job dispatch (POST /api/v8/companion/dispatch) returning REMOTE_COMPANION_UNREACHABLE when offline.

P0-04.title: Production Fault-Injection Parameter Exposure
P0-04.implementation: Removed simulated_fault from public GET endpoints via _resolve_internal_test_fault() (requires X-ENGR852-Internal-Test-Mode: 1 + owner/companion auth) and removed automatic simulated_fault='VPN_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE' on macbook_air.

P0-05.title: Unauthenticated Device-Selection Mutation and Default Live-Frame Fallback
P0-05.implementation: Protected POST /api/v8/devices/select with require_owner_companion=True + require_csrf=True, and removed default fig10_v803_live_imac fallback on GET /api/v8/verdi/live-frame.png (requires explicit job_id and validates fig_id/state).

P0-06.title: Duplicate Signal Rails in Wrapped Verdi Tcl Execution
P0-06.implementation: Updated build_defect_d_safe_tcl_wrapper() in engr852_native_verdi_bridge.py to clear existing nWave signal groups (wvSelectAll + wvCut) before populating the canonical 17-signal list once in G1.

P0-07.title: Cached Live-Run Manifest Can Masquerade as Current Live Execution
P0-07.implementation: Updated get_live_connection_status() and get_native_verdi_live_status() so closed X11 windows downgrade to VERDI_PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING / RECORDED_VERIFIED_CAPTURE with is_live_stream=False.
